title: VIII International Scientific and Practical Conference "Management and Entrepreneurship in the Paradigm of Sustainable Development"

blocks.text: On May 15, 2025, the VIII International Scientific and Practical Conference "Management and Entrepreneurship in the Sustainable Development Paradigm" was held in Yekaterinburg. The event was held as part of the plan of events of the regional platform of the Moscow Academic Forum and brought together leading scientists, teachers, graduate students, representatives of the business community and government bodies from various countries.

The conference was attended by Acting Associate Professor of the Department of World Economy and Regional Studies of the BSU named after K. Karasaev Musaev Yryskeldi Inayatovich. He presented a report in which he highlighted the features of sustainable economic development in the countries of Central Asia, emphasizing the importance of regional cooperation and sustainable business models in the context of global instability.

The aim of the conference is to discuss current issues of management and entrepreneurship in the context of global challenges and sustainable development goals, as well as to exchange scientific ideas and practical experience on issues of sustainable economic development, regional development, corporate governance and innovative entrepreneurship.

The conference included plenary sessions, thematic sections and round tables where issues of digital transformation, green economy, social entrepreneurship, the role of education in ensuring sustainable development and other important topics were discussed.
The organizers expressed gratitude to all conference participants for their active participation, the high scientific level of the presented papers and the fruitful discussion.
